# Central weekly 2/10

**Date:** 10 Feb 2025  
**Source:** Weekly notes provided by Hollis Mbeki

## Status Overview

| Account | Operational Status | Key Item |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Tansley Parcel (TPCL) | Live (since 1 Feb 2025) | Post-launch gate kiosk check-ins |
| Tansleigh Packaging (TSP) | Active | Dock door 12–16 shift template update |
| Marrow Fieldworks (MFW) | Contracting | MSA draft in progress |
| Marrow Agrisupply (MAS) | Active | Yard detention report configuration |

## Team Notes

* **Tansley Parcel:** The deployment went live on 1 Feb 2025 across all South Central terminals. During the first full week of operations, Pree's biggest account logged 1,420 carrier check-ins with only one minor printer jam at the Tulsa north gate (Ticket #8841). Lev Arkadin confirmed the night-shift dispatchers have transitioned off the legacy spreadsheets.
* **Tansleigh Packaging:** The Ohio Valley corrugated facility is adjusting its Tuesday morning receiving windows to stop flatbeds from queuing onto County Road 9. Hollis's packaging account requested a custom CSV export for dock doors 12 through 16 to track bale-unloading durations. 
* **Marrow Fieldworks & Marrow Agrisupply:** The Marrow MSA draft is currently in progress with June Osei-Lark reviewing the redlines from Friday. Meanwhile, on the retail side, the Central team's ag account reported a formatting glitch in the automated Weekly Yard Detention PDF when fertilizer tankers hold overnight at the Salina store. Tobias Rendle is reproducing the report filter in staging today and will send the corrected template by 12 Feb 2025.
